title: Holy cow: Paris Agriculture Fair moo-ves forward without the bovine
summary: The Paris Agriculture Fair, or Salon de L'Agriculture, is an institution in France. It's a must for politicians, but its star attractions – the cows – are missing this year. In this edition, we dive into why they aren't there, why politicians flock to the event, and the weight of la vache, or the cow, in the French language and culture.
